name: photosynthesis-entity-resolution
description: A deterministic gold-standard fixture for evaluating semantic entity resolution independently of Stage A extraction. Embedding similarity may propose pairs, but only a semantic verifier may authorize a merge.

entities.name: CO₂
context: CO₂ is attached to RuBP by RuBisCO.

entities.name: carbon dioxide
context: Carbon dioxide is fixed during the Calvin cycle.

entities.name: G3P
context: G3P is produced during the reduction phase of the Calvin cycle.

entities.name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate
context: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate is a three-carbon sugar produced by the Calvin cycle.

entities.name: Calvin cycle
context: The Calvin cycle fixes carbon in the chloroplast stroma using ATP and NADPH.

entities.name: light-independent reactions
context: The light-independent reactions use ATP and NADPH to fix carbon in the chloroplast stroma.

entities.name: carbon fixation
context: Carbon fixation is the process that incorporates carbon dioxide into an organic molecule.

entities.name: CO₂ concentration
context: CO₂ concentration can limit the rate of photosynthesis.

entities.name: oxygen
context: Oxygen is released when water is split during the light-dependent reactions.

labeled_pairs.rationale: CO₂ is the chemical formula and an alias for carbon dioxide.
G3P is the standard abbreviation for glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate.
In this source context, light-independent reactions names the Calvin cycle rather than a separate entity.
CO₂ is a chemical compound; carbon fixation is a process that uses it. Related entities must not be merged.
CO₂ concentration is a measured property or condition involving CO₂, not the compound itself.
Oxygen and carbon dioxide are distinct chemical compounds despite appearing in the same photosynthesis contexts.

evaluation_contract.candidate_recall: The fraction of expected same_entity pairs emitted by the embedding candidate generator.
evaluation_contract.false_positive_rate: Among labeled different_entity pairs, the fraction incorrectly resolved as same_entity.
evaluation_contract.unresolved_pairs: Labeled pairs for which the verifier returns uncertain, produces no decision, or fails.
evaluation_contract.entity_count_before: The number of fixture entities before semantic merging; expected to equal expected_entity_count_before.
evaluation_contract.entity_count_after: The number of graph entities after confirmed merges and reference rewriting; expected to equal expected_entity_count_after.
evaluation_contract.merge_rule: Only same_entity decisions may merge nodes. Embedding similarity is candidate-generation evidence, never a merge decision.
